units.name: BuildTileStripQueueAddress
units.summary: Input normalized map coordinates in Work0041..Work0044 and queue index X. Compute the nametable tile address, reserve the three-byte queue header and save its payload start in Scratch0F.

units.name: BuildAttributeStripQueueAddress
units.summary: Input normalized map coordinates and queue index X. Derive the $23c0-based attribute destination and reserve its three-byte header; Scratch01/02 also retain the computed address.

units.name: ResolveMapCellPointer
units.summary: Compute the map-cell address from normalized Y/page and world X, using the repeated packed row layout at CPU $885c. Return the pointer in Scratch01/02; table identity is local to effective banks0/1.

units.name: ResolveMapTileRecord
units.summary: Read a map cell, multiply its metatile ID by sixteen and add CPU $8a9c. Return the tile-record pointer in Scratch04/05 and the selected tile offset in Y from the low coordinate bits.

units.name: ResolveAttributeMapPointer
units.summary: Use the same packed map row arithmetic to return a cell pointer in Scratch03/04 for palette-nibble merging. Scratch05/06 hold intermediate byte pairs.

units.name: LookupWorldMapTile
units.summary: Normalize world Y, derive its map cell and metatile pointer, then return the selected tile offset in Y. The fixed wrapper reads the resulting pointer; no CPU execution is inferred from cell contents.
